operators.customDisplayName: Load CSV file data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2012.csv (water body testing samples for 2012).
Load CSV file data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2013.csv (water body testing samples for 2013).

operatorProperties.code:
def process(wb2012, wb2013):
    g2012 = wb2012.groupby(["Community","Beach Name"]).agg(samples_2012=("Violation","size"), violations_2012=("Violation", lambda s: (s.str.lower()=="yes").sum())).reset_index()
    g2012["rate_2012"] = g2012["violations_2012"]/g2012["samples_2012"]
    g2013 = wb2013.groupby(["Community","Beach Name"]).agg(samples_2013=("Violation","size"), violations_2013=("Violation", lambda s: (s.str.lower()=="yes").sum())).reset_index()
    g2013["rate_2013"] = g2013["violations_2013"]/g2013["samples_2013"]
    merged = g2012.merge(g2013, on=["Community","Beach Name"], how="left")
    merged["rate_2013"] = merged["rate_2013"].fillna(0)
    result = merged[(merged["samples_2012"]>0) & (merged["rate_2013"]>merged["rate_2012"])].copy()
    result = result.sort_values(["Community","Beach Name"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    return result

operators.customDisplayName: For each (Community, Beach Name) compute sample counts and violation counts for 2012 and 2013, calculate exceedance rates (violations/samples), merge by Community+Beach Name, exclude beaches with 0 samples in 2012, and keep rows where 2013 rate > 2012 rate. Outputs one row per beach with columns: Community, Beach Name, samples_2012, violations_2012, rate_2012, samples_2013, violations_2013, rate_2013.
